data.title: Turkish Regulator Orders Suspension and Liquidation of Funds Linked to Güler Yatırım Holding
data.description:
The latest update is out from Guler Yatirim Holding A.S. ( (TR:GLRYH) ).

Güler Yatırım Holding reported that Türkiye’s Capital Markets Board has ordered investment funds established by its shareholder Pardus Portföy and indirectly held A1 Capital Portföy, and traded on the Türkiye Electronic Fund Trading Platform, to be closed to trading and subsequently liquidated under procedures to be set by the regulator. As a result, purchases and sales in these funds have been suspended, and the liquidation process will follow applicable legislation, regulatory principles, and fund information documents.

The company stated that Pardus Portföy and A1 Capital Portföy are working closely with the capital markets regulator and other authorities to ensure full compliance with the decision. Güler Yatırım Holding emphasized that its corporate operations and group activities continue uninterrupted, urged investors to rely solely on its official communication channels and competent authorities for information, and pledged to keep the market informed as developments unfold in line with its transparency commitments.

data.title: Net Holding Nears 10% Treasury Stake as Share Buy-Back Advances
data.description:
An announcement from Net Holding A.S. ( (TR:NTHOL) ) is now available.

Net Holding A.Ş. has been executing a share buy-back program approved by its extraordinary general assembly, authorizing the board to repurchase up to 18.2 million shares, equivalent to 3.64% of capital, with a fund allocation of TL 850 million over a defined multi-year window. The program aims to support fair share valuation, mitigate extraordinary negative price movements driven by macroeconomic or geopolitical factors, and enhance liquidity in its stock on Borsa İstanbul.

Under this framework, the company repurchased shares on 18 September 2026 at prices between TL 37.70 and TL 38.68, lifting treasury ownership to 9.84% of its own capital, close to the 10% statutory ceiling for buy-backs. The scheme includes strict limits on daily volumes, total cost and price bands tied to book value, and empowers the board to suspend or terminate purchases based on market conditions, underscoring active capital management and signaling support for shareholders amid volatility.

data.title: Adecoagro Secures BB Fitch Rating with Stable Outlook After Profertil Acquisition
data.description:
The latest update is out from Adecoagro SA ( (AGRO) ).

On September 18, 2026, Adecoagro S.A. announced that Fitch Ratings initiated coverage of the company, assigning BB long-term local and foreign currency issuer default ratings with a Stable Outlook. Fitch’s assessment highlights Adecoagro’s stronger financial profile, supported by nearly doubled consolidated EBITDA and cash flow following its acquisition of Profertil, which added a leading fertilizers business and broadened its earnings base.

The rating also reflects Fitch’s view that Adecoagro’s net leverage should continue to decline as higher EBITDA and ongoing debt reduction bolster the balance sheet. Diversified funding sources, continued access to capital markets and banks, and strong shareholder support underpin the company’s financial flexibility, potentially improving its standing with lenders and investors and reinforcing its resilience through commodity cycles.
